newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian ATX ends weak, pick-up seen after expiry.
newsitem.headline: Austrian ATX ends weak, pick-up seen after expiry.

text.p: 1325 GMT - Austrian shares end softer although traders predict some pick-up after expiry of June futures and options on Friday. Strong demand in Verbund, Flughafen and insurer EA Generali, dealers said.
* ATX index down 0.45 percent or 5.92 points at 1,297.47 points.
* 13 ATX shares lower, seven higher, one unchanged.
* Top ATX decliner Leykam, down 1.56 percent at 310 schillings.
* Leading ATX gainer Brau Union, up 2.57 percent at 759 schillings.
* June ATX future down 12 points at 1,292. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
